nodes.name: One-step solvothermal Mo-MOFs derivation
nodes.procedure: The experimental steps for the preparation of 1T-MoS₂ are described in Scheme 1a. Specifically, a homogeneous mixture of solutions stirred at room temperature first gave Mo-based MOFs (Mo-PTA, with phthalic acid as ligand) at 120°C, which were converted to 1T-MoS₂ nanoflowers after heating to 200°C. Reaction time was set to 24 h. N,N-dimethylformamide (DMF) was employed as solvent for increasing the 2D crystalline surface spacing.

nodes.characterization_summary: 2H-MoS₂ shows (002) peak at 2θ=14.12° corresponding to d=6.22 Å; 180-1T-MoS₂ (002) shifts to 2θ=9.46° (d=8.57 Å); 200-1T-MoS₂ (002) at 2θ=8.12° (d=10.87 Å).
nodes.evidence_snippet: Three major XRD diffraction peaks corresponding to (002), (101), and (106) crystal planes exist at 2θ = 14.12°, 33.98°, and 56.86° for 2H-MoS₂, respectively (Figure 2a) ... when the temperature was increased to 200°C, the DMF oxide as external stress continued to expand the (002) crystalline plane spacing to 10.87 Å, and the (002) face of 200-1T-MoS₂ was shifted to the smaller angle 2θ = 8.12°.

nodes.characterization_summary: 2H-MoS₂: E₂g¹=381.9 cm⁻¹, A₁g=404.8 cm⁻¹; 180/200-1T-MoS₂: E₁g=282.1 cm⁻¹, J₁=149 cm⁻¹, J₂=239 cm⁻¹, J₃=336 cm⁻¹ confirming 1T phase superlattice distortions.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 2b shows E₂g¹ and A₁g vibration at ≈381.9 and 404.8 cm⁻¹ of 2H-MoS₂ respectively ... three peaks of J₁, J₂, and J₃ at ≈149, 239, and 336 cm⁻¹ correspond to superlattice distortions in the basal plane of 180-1T-MoS₂ and 200-1T-MoS₂.

nodes.characterization_summary: 2H-MoS₂: Mo 3d₅/₂=229.9 eV, 3d₃/₂=233.1 eV; 200-1T-MoS₂: Mo 3d shifted -0.9 eV to 229/232.2 eV, S 2p to 161.7/162.8 eV confirming pure 1T phase.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In Figure 2c, the Mo 3d absorption peaks at 229.9 and 233.1 eV for 2H-MoS₂ correspond to the Mo⁴⁺ 3d₅/₂ and 3d₃/₂ ... The 200-1T-MoS₂ absorption peaks are both shifted by about 0.9 eV toward the lower binding energy to 229 and 232.2 eV.

nodes.characterization_summary: 2H-MoS₂ shows absorption peaks at 482, 625, 697 nm (semiconducting); 1T-MoS₂ shows no distinct peaks in visible range (metallic nature).
nodes.evidence_snippet: 200-1T-MoS₂ and 180-1T-MoS₂ dispersion in water has no significant absorption peaks in the visible range ... the 2H-MoS₂ dispersion has three absorption peaks in the visible range.

nodes.characterization_summary: Direct lattice measurements: 2H-MoS₂ (002)=6.18 Å; 180-1T-MoS₂=8.52 Å; 200-1T-MoS₂=10.83 Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 1d shows the (002) crystalline surface of 2H-MoS₂ with a crystalline spacing of ≈6.18 Å, consistent with that reported by Gao ... A larger interlayer spacing of ≈8.52 and 10.83 Å was found for 180-1T-MoS₂ and 200-1T-MoS₂ in Figure 1i-n, respectively.
